# Third-party attribution: Applied Energistics 2

Some of AURELIUM's item textures are recoloured derivatives of Applied Energistics 2's
portable-cell artwork, which is licensed under the **GNU LGPL-3.0**. This file records that
attribution; `LICENSE` and `GPL-3.txt` in this directory are the corresponding license texts and
must travel with the distribution.

## Upstream

- Project: Applied Energistics 2 (Team Applied Energistics)
- Repository: https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2
- Reference version: `neoforge/v19.2.17`
- License: GNU LGPL-3.0

## Derived assets

These files are recoloured from AE2's portable-cell layer textures:

| AURELIUM file | Derived from |
| --- | --- |
| `assets/aurelium/textures/item/ae_pink_base.png` | `portable_cell_item_housing.png` |
| `assets/aurelium/textures/item/ae_pink_led.png` | `portable_cell_led.png` |
| `assets/aurelium/textures/item/ae_pink_screen.png` | `portable_cell_screen.png` |
| `assets/aurelium/textures/item/ae_pink_side.png` | `portable_cell_side_256k.png` |

## Original assets

The other textures in `assets/aurelium/` (the flow/halo overlays, the infinite cell and disk
textures, the pattern-tool icons, and the drive cell textures) are AURELIUM's own and are not
covered by the LGPL-3.0 derivative terms.

## License obligations

The derived textures above are distributed under the LGPL-3.0, so the license texts and this
attribution are shipped inside the jar at `META-INF/aurelium/third_party/ae2/`. The root
`LICENSE` (MIT) applies only to AURELIUM's own code and original assets; it does not cover the
AE2-derived textures.
